verdict.rationale: Extend's data-handling docs describe zero data retention options, configurable at the workspace level and extending to AI subprocessors, plus deletion APIs for every resource; ZDR is also listed on the pricing page. On compliance, the docs state SOC 2 Type II-aligned controls with reports available in a Trust Center, and pricing lists a HIPAA compliance and BAA add-on, so the story's core is covered. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of ZDR/HIPAA in practice, an explicit SOC 2 attestation (the wording is only 'aligned with'), and clarity on which billing tiers include ZDR versus HIPAA as a paid add-on.
